summary: Create a role with `ansible-galaxy role init <role_name>`, ideally inside a collection's roles directory, which generates defaults, files, handlers, meta, tasks, templates, tests and vars; use --role-skeleton for a custom template.
questions: How do I create an Ansible role?
What directories does ansible-galaxy role init create?
How do I use a custom role skeleton?
Should roles live inside a collection?

answer_card.title: Create a role in a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd ~/.ansible/collections/ansible_collections/<ns>/<collection>/roles
ansible-galaxy role init my_role
# custom template
ansible-galaxy role init my_role --role-skeleton ~/role_skeleton
```
Creates `defaults/ files/ handlers/ meta/ tasks/ templates/ tests/ vars/` and `README.md`.
